title: Numerical validation for "Function Space Analysis of Piecewise-Linear Energy Functionals under Łukasiewicz Fuzzy Semantics"
description:
Companion code for the manuscript Function Space Analysis of Piecewise-Linear Energy Functionals under Łukasiewicz Fuzzy Semantics (Zanardo & Ragusa, 2026).

This repository contains the self-contained Python script numerical_validation.py that reproduces, in under one minute on a single CPU core and under a fixed random seed, every numerical figure reported in Section 8 of the manuscript: Monte‐Carlo estimates of the partition function, an empirical reflected-Langevin mixing time, the leading-order Laplace asymptotic, and the empirical scaling of the weight norm W(n).

Dependencies: numpy, scipy. License: MIT.
